'''Majzon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblood Sith]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he resided on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Majzon was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as Imperial-side vendor for Galactic Command system.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
